constraints: Technical branches contribute analytical detection support only.
Blood detection and activity do not establish pulmonary disease.
mNGS reads/RPM are not qPCR viral load.
Clinician activity interpretation and pulmonary attribution require source-verified, organism-specific, episode-aligned claims.
A qPCR number alone is not proof of replication or organ disease; interpretation depends on virus, assay, specimen and host.
Clinical claims must declare review_complete=true. Unstructured history flags alone cannot establish activity or organ disease.
An empty structured-claim set means evidence extraction/verification incomplete, not clinical absence.
This shadow does not change production decisions or benchmark answers.
